tract: Lettres du Roy Francois premier & instructions a ses Ambassadeurs...avec le Roy d'Angleterre Henry 8 (own foliation 1-217; canvas = 155+2*(folio-1) recto, 156+2*(folio-1) verso)
pass: print-check worker for LANE V, folios 91-217 recto (excl. 120/150/180 already read in prior sampling pass) plus requested versos f.2v-3v/f.34v/f.64v/f.82v-84v and the discovered England-affair dossier versos f.171v-177v (24 Sept 2026)
note: No 20 May 1530 letter from Gramont to Villandry or the King found. The tract's text itself ends 'FIN' at f.211r (signed du Prat, 28 Dec 1532); f.212r-217r are unrelated filler (Dinteville family deeds, 1429/1594 Troyes municipal documents). A genuine dossier of Gramont-authored letters to the Pope on the Henry VIII divorce affair was found at f.171v-178r ('Fin des lettres de l'affaire d'Angleterre'), all dated 1531-1534 -- not 20 May 1530, not addressed to Villandry or the King. Most folios were fetched to disk, read this session, then deleted (not committed) to stay under the 30MB/folder cap; 4 representative images are committed (dossier start/Gramont-header/dossier-end/tract-FIN); re-fetch any other folio from its url above (one request, 1.5s+ apart).
